citation.authors: Rustad AM, Nickles MA, McKenney JE, Bilimoria SN, Lio PA

cited_by.title: Collagen for hair, nails and joints

record.population: Claims on Instagram and YouTube, by collagen companies, and in the literature
record.design: Review of social media, company and published claims
record.finding: Some studies show better skin elasticity and hydration, but dermatology claims in the media go beyond the evidence; the authors say more research is needed.
record.note: A review of claims. The abstract does not give the evidence for hair or nails separately.
